name: Friedberg (Bavaria, Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and blue, charged above the centre with the city arms of Friedberg (a red cross between fleurs-de-lis on a mount).
history: Municipal flag of Friedberg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.
